classes.name: operate
classes.meaning: Changes state in a way an agent may do on its own, such as deny, cancel, pause or stop.

classes.name: decide
classes.meaning: A decision that belongs to a person, such as allowing a request or loosening a permission. Needs the human gate.

classes.name: decide-legacy
classes.meaning: A decision whose current behaviour predates the gate and is kept as is. The registry makes it visible.

gateTiers.name: T1T2
gateTiers.meaning: A controlling terminal in the foreground (T1) and a one-time code typed at /dev/tty (T2).

gateTiers.name: T3
gateTiers.meaning: Reserved for OS owner authentication. Not supported yet: it answers unsupported-platform.
